ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Full capacity for action comes into view rather than remaining merely available or described.
EvidenceBody: The expression occurs 447 times in 170 allowlisted texts and often continues with the statement that established rules are not retained. Dazhu Huihai directly equates the appearing of great function with the unequalled body of the teaching. A reviewed unnamed monk asks Changqing Da'an what happens when great function appears without retaining rules; Changqing answers, “If you can use it, just use it.” Fengxue Yanzhao tells the assembly that at the encounter great function must appear and that they must not constrain themselves to small details. Yunmen Wenyan states the stock line; a second reviewed unnamed monk immediately asks what the appearing of great function is, and Yunmen raises his staff and calls out that old man Shakyamuni has come. Yuanwu Keqin pairs the stock line with using a blade of grass as a sixteen-foot golden body and the golden body as a blade of grass. Dahui Zonggao reports that students of sayings apply the phrase to Guizong's killing a snake and Nanquan's killing a cat, then explicitly rejects that account. Zen makes a phrase about capacity becoming present into a public question, an assembly demand, and a case-commentary formula; the different answers and Dahui's rejection prevent any one action from becoming its hidden definition.
